actor: Technical accounting lead, NVIDIA external reporting
job: Deciding which OpenAI-related guarantees meet recognition and disclosure thresholds, and what maximum potential future payment figure enters NVIDIA's commitments-and-contingencies note.
outcome: 10-Q and 10-K commitments notes that quantify NVIDIA's guarantee exposure near its reported $3.5 billion book, far below $25 billion.
motivation: Unsigned talks with OpenAI and SB Energy carry no executed instrument, so no maximum potential future payment is quantifiable yet.

task.who: NVIDIA technical accounting and SEC reporting group
task.what: Scope guarantee disclosure to executed instruments only
task.why: Unsigned Piketon talks create no quantifiable maximum payment
task.how: ASC 460 criteria, auditor review, disclosure committee sign-off

actor: Structured finance negotiator, NVIDIA treasury and corporate development
job: Negotiating with OpenAI, SB Energy and their lenders to attach any NVIDIA credit support to Piketon's 800-megawatt first phase only.
outcome: A phase-scoped guarantee around $20 billion against first-phase draws, leaving the $250 billion campus figure an unsigned negotiating notional.
motivation: NVIDIA closed roughly 5% lower on the Wall Street Journal report; a staged commitment protects both the balance sheet and the shares.

task.who: NVIDIA treasury, corporate development and outside transaction counsel
task.what: Cap NVIDIA credit support at first-phase draw schedule
task.where: Term sheets with OpenAI, SB Energy and lenders
task.why: A smaller staged number keeps the filing small
task.how: Tranche-by-tranche caps, draw-schedule triggers, phase-completion conditions precedent

actor: Project finance lead, SB Energy, the SoftBank-backed Piketon developer
job: Sequencing the ten-gigawatt Piketon campus into buildable phases, starting with 800 megawatts targeting 2028 on the former Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant site.
outcome: A phased construction and draw schedule under which only first-phase financing can be guaranteed before the end of 2027.
motivation: Power, permits and turbine delivery gate construction; SB Energy cannot draw campus-wide financing for capacity it has not built.

task.who: SB Energy development, EPC and project finance teams
task.what: Sequence Piketon construction and draws into 800-megawatt phases
task.where: Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant site, Piketon, Ohio
task.why: Guarantees attach to draws, and draws follow construction
task.how: Phased interconnection queue, milestone-based EPC contracts, staged notice-to-proceed

actor: Credit committee chair, Piketon lease-financing bank syndicate
job: Underwriting a first-phase facility sized to NVIDIA credit support that NVIDIA will actually sign, rather than to the reported $250 billion headline.
outcome: A signed facility whose guaranteed maximum sits near first-phase economics, roughly $20 billion, keeping NVIDIA's filed exposure under $25 billion.
motivation: OpenAI holds no investment-grade rating, so lenders underwrite NVIDIA's credit and can only deploy against capacity being built now.

task.who: Syndicate credit committees and project-finance underwriting teams
task.what: Size the first-phase facility to signed NVIDIA support
task.where: Bank syndicate credit committees and Piketon facility term sheets
task.why: Only built capacity supports a fundable draw schedule
task.how: Phase-one collateral packages, drawdown conditions, guarantee caps per tranche

job: Answering the guarantee question with NVIDIA's own filed figures: $3.5 billion of guarantees, $712 million escrowed, $62.6 billion cash, not the reported notional.
outcome: Earnings calls, 8-Ks and NVIDIA-published announcements that never state a maximum potential future payment at or above $25 billion.
motivation: The Wall Street Journal report cost NVIDIA roughly 5% in one session; repeating an unsigned quarter-trillion figure would repeat the damage.

task.who: NVIDIA investor relations and the disclosure committee
task.what: Communicate guarantee exposure using filed figures only
task.where: Earnings calls, 8-K filings and NVIDIA newsroom releases
task.why: Reported notionals are not NVIDIA's quantified obligations
task.how: Disclosure committee review, Regulation FD controls, scripted call responses

actor: Deal lead, NVIDIA OpenAI-account chip financing
job: Keeping the separate negotiation of up to $350 billion of NVIDIA chip financing on its own instruments, away from the Piketon lease guarantee.
outcome: Two unconsolidated tracks, so neither the chip-financing notional nor the lease notional aggregates into one filed guarantee maximum.
motivation: Combining the lease and chip tracks in one footnote would push NVIDIA's stated maximum past $25 billion on paperwork alone.

task.who: NVIDIA corporate development, sales finance and securities counsel
task.what: Separate chip-financing instruments from the Piketon lease guarantee
task.where: Vendor-financing agreements and OpenAI supply contract documentation
task.why: Aggregated notionals would inflate one filed maximum
task.how: Distinct counterparties, separate credit agreements, non-cross-collateralized structures

actor: Capital markets lead, OpenAI corporate finance
job: Pursuing an investment-grade rating from Moody's, S&P Global Ratings and Fitch, and spreading Piketon lease credit support across SoftBank and other backers.
outcome: Lease financing that leans on OpenAI's own credit and multiple backers, so no single NVIDIA guarantee needs to reach $25 billion.
motivation: Depending on a chip supplier to guarantee its rent gives NVIDIA leverage over OpenAI's cost of capital and its roadmap.

task.who: OpenAI treasury, corporate finance and ratings advisory teams
task.what: Build a rated standalone credit for Piketon lease financing
task.where: Rating agency processes and lease financing negotiations
task.why: Own rating reduces reliance on NVIDIA's balance sheet
task.how: Audited financials, contracted revenue disclosure, agency rating presentations
